unit_cn: Unit 2 Looking into the Future 展望未来
source: 人教版2019选择性必修一 Unit 2 词表(真词);IPA 标准词典英音回填;例句原创、科技与未来生活主题、含目标词、不超纲;多义词给多个中文释义。

words.example_en: Scientists predict that robots will do most housework in the future.
words.example_cn: 科学家预测,未来机器人将承担大部分家务。

words.example_en: His prediction about smart homes has already come true.
words.example_cn: 他对智能家居的预测已经成真。

words.example_en: Experts forecast that AI will change the way we work.
words.example_cn: 专家预测人工智能将改变我们的工作方式。

words.example_en: Living in a fully automatic home is an exciting prospect.
words.example_cn: 住在全自动化的家中是个令人兴奋的前景。

words.meaning_cn: 可能的;潜在的;潜力;可能性
words.example_en: Smart sensors can detect potential dangers before they happen.
words.example_cn: 智能传感器能在危险发生前察觉潜在的风险。

words.example_en: A smart toilet could potentially save your life by finding illness early.
words.example_cn: 智能马桶能及早发现疾病,从而可能挽救你的生命。

words.example_en: Many of these new innovations are already being used in some homes.
words.example_cn: 许多这样的新创造已经在一些家庭中使用了。

words.example_en: A smart home integrates computers into the structure of the building itself.
words.example_cn: 智能家居把计算机融入了建筑本身的结构中。

words.meaning_cn: 各部分密切协调的;综合的
words.example_en: The future home will use integrated sensors to tell when you leave.
words.example_cn: 未来的家会用综合传感器来判断你何时离开。

words.example_en: The house goes into an energy-efficient mode all by itself.
words.example_cn: 这座房子会自动进入节能模式。

words.example_en: Smart toilets keep constant track of your health every day.
words.example_cn: 智能马桶每天持续追踪你的健康状况。

words.meaning_cn: 严重的;关键的;批判性的
words.example_en: The device can warn you early if you have a critical illness.
words.example_cn: 这种设备能在你患重病时及早发出警告。

words.example_en: If a water pipe leaks, your smart home will detect it at once.
words.example_cn: 如果水管漏水,你的智能家居会立刻察觉。

words.example_en: The home uses sensors to tell when you enter or leave the room.
words.example_cn: 这座房子用传感器来判断你何时进出房间。

words.example_en: You will no longer have to turn switches on and off yourself.
words.example_cn: 你再也不必自己开关那些开关了。

words.meaning_cn: 安全的;牢固的;获得;保护
words.example_en: Smart homes will keep us secure and save us energy.
words.example_cn: 智能家居会保障我们的安全并节省能源。

words.example_en: Cameras and sensors greatly improve home security.
words.example_cn: 摄像头和传感器大大提升了家庭安全。

words.example_en: We can control these machines from a remote place by phone.
words.example_cn: 我们可以用手机从远处控制这些机器。

words.example_en: Your home will learn your daily routine and preferences.
words.example_cn: 你的家会学会你的日常生活和偏好。

words.example_en: The system remembers your preferences and gets everything ready.
words.example_cn: 系统会记住你的偏好并把一切准备好。

words.example_en: All controls respond to your voice, and the home system will obey.
words.example_cn: 所有控制都对你的语音作出反应,家居系统会照做。

words.example_en: Just say aloud what you want, and the home will follow your commands.
words.example_cn: 只要把想做的事说出来,家就会执行你的指令。

words.example_en: If a water pipe starts to leak, the home will warn you in time.
words.example_cn: 如果水管开始漏水,这座房子会及时提醒你。

words.example_en: The system can find a problem in the electrical wires before a fire.
words.example_cn: 系统能在起火前发现电线里的问题。

words.example_en: If there is a short in the electrical wiring, the home will detect it.
words.example_cn: 如果电线线路短路,这座房子会察觉到。

words.example_en: The smart bed will send a warning to your phone if something is wrong.
words.example_cn: 如果出现异常,智能床会向你的手机发送警告。

words.example_en: This smart technology is not a fantasy but a real part of today's life.
words.example_cn: 这种智能技术不是幻想,而是今天生活的真实部分。

words.example_en: The Amish prefer a simple life to caring about luxuries.
words.example_cn: 阿米什人更喜欢简单生活,而不在意奢华享受。

words.example_en: I found my career as an AI designer through a social media network.
words.example_cn: 我通过社交媒体找到了人工智能设计师的职业。

words.example_en: Many new kinds of occupation will appear as technology develops.
words.example_cn: 随着科技发展,许多新职业将会出现。

words.example_en: Some people oppose the idea of developing driverless cars.
words.example_cn: 有些人反对发展无人驾驶汽车的想法。

words.example_en: I will accept new technology rather than resist it.
words.example_cn: 我会接受新技术,而不是抵制它。

words.example_en: New technology often meets some resistance at first.
words.example_cn: 新技术起初常常遇到一些抵制。

words.example_en: We should not cease accepting technology just because it is new.
words.example_cn: 我们不该仅仅因为技术是新的就停止接受它。

words.example_en: The families of the deceased said the apology was not enough.
words.example_cn: 死者的家属表示道歉还不够。

words.example_en: The Amish are a group of people living in rural America.
words.example_cn: 阿米什人是一群生活在美国乡村的人。

words.example_en: They live a simple life with an emphasis on hard work and family.
words.example_cn: 他们过着简单的生活,重视勤劳和家庭。

words.example_en: The home will give you all the relevant information about the problem.
words.example_cn: 这座房子会向你提供关于问题的所有相关信息。

words.example_en: In the not-too-distant future, we will be living in smart homes.
words.example_cn: 在不太遥远的将来,我们将住在智能家居里。

words.example_en: Your lights will come on the instant you enter the door.
words.example_cn: 你一进门,灯就会立刻亮起。

words.example_en: The car crashed while it was in driverless mode.
words.example_cn: 那辆车在无人驾驶模式下发生了碰撞。

words.example_en: A smart home builds computers into the structure of the building.
words.example_cn: 智能家居把计算机建入建筑的结构之中。

words.example_en: Designers combine new sensors and software to make homes smarter.
words.example_cn: 设计师把新传感器和软件结合起来,让家更智能。

words.example_en: Some advances may be dangerous; hence we should be careful.
words.example_cn: 有些进步可能很危险,因此我们应当谨慎。

words.example_en: Change can be scary; nevertheless, I always look on the positive side.
words.example_cn: 改变可能令人害怕;尽管如此,我总是看积极的一面。

words.example_en: He is writing an essay on the pros and cons of new technology.
words.example_cn: 他正在写一篇关于新技术利弊的文章。

words.example_en: New advances in technology have brought people many benefits.
words.example_cn: 技术上的新进步给人们带来了许多好处。

words.example_en: We will use technology for the automatic control of our whole home.
words.example_cn: 我们将用技术来自动控制整个家。
